svg.text: Storage layout of the 3.6 m machine — how a box reaches the cell
Freezer, fridge and ambient column stand along the wall; one gallery above them carries every box along one pick line.
one gallery X axis, one hoist (≥ 450 mm), one passive gripper
≈ 10 s gallery time per box, ≈ 6 min per 4-person meal
two stub carriers (stub ends at y ≈ 200)
pick 2 s · travel 2 s · lid off 3 s · lower and release 3 s
stores pre-fetch from the menu plan ≥ 30 min ahead
1/5 Freezer box: the gallery stops over the freezer, the top-wall slide opens 3.4 s, the hook takes the box off the port stack.
2/5 Along the one pick line to the cell shaft: the lid station keeps the lid, the box drops into stub carrier 1 on the shelf.
3/5 Fridge box: the same moves over the fridge (the busier cold store sits next to the ambient column) into carrier 2.
4/5 Put-away: the used box gets its lid back and is set on the S4 carriage, which hangs it back in its rack slot.
5/5 Ambient box: the carriage brings it to the roof hatch, 60 mm below the gallery; the hook takes it to carrier 1.
